scripts.build:desktop: node scripts/create-desktop-icon.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.desktop.json && node scripts/build-desktop.mjs && node scripts/prepare-desktop-package.mjs
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build && npm run build:desktop && electron .
scripts.package:windows: npm run build && npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --projectDir desktop-package --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --x64 && node scripts/publish-windows-installer.mjs
scripts.package:macos: node scripts/require-macos-build-host.mjs && npm run build && npm run build:desktop && electron-builder --projectDir desktop-package --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg --universal && node scripts/publish-macos-installer.mjs
